photos.desc: This is a half cow, half buffalo. Her 1/4 cow, 3/4 buffalo calf is 6 months old.
Roast beef from Beefalo (a hybrid of domestic cattle and American bison) with gravy, carrots and potato wedges. Photographed at Tammy's Country Kitchen in Napanee, Canada.
Buddy the beefalo is pictured at his home at Critter Creek Farm Sanctuary in Gainesville, Florida.
